notes.content: W3-4 DONE (2026-08-25, /root/projects/rmmway). W4-1 DONE (2026-08-25, /root/projects/rmmway). CycloneDX SBOM per artifact: release v0.5.0 = 29 assets — every artifact ships <artifact>.cdx.json (CycloneDX 1.7 JSON, pinned syft 1.51.0 via scripts/install-syft.sh, sha256-verified; scripts/sbom.sh; make sbom / sbom-agent / image). Agent SBOMs = 13 Go modules + binary sha256 in metadata.component.version; server image SBOM = 23 Go modules + 5 distroless deb OS packages (base-files, ca-certificates, media-types, netbase, tzdata) + debian 12.15 OS component + ~950 files (282KB). Image SBOM in CI: buildx outputs: type=docker,dest=server-image.tar (works WITH push:true) → syft docker-archive: (no registry auth needed). Server image SBOM: cosign attach sbom --type cyclonedx to GHCR digest (cosign 3.x: command is `attach sbom` subcommand, NOT attach-sbom; deprecated but present in 3.0.6 = cosign-installer@v3 default; media type application/vnd.cyclonedx+json). All 6 SBOMs minisigned (sign.sh now 13-artifact set incl. 5 agent SBOMs + SHA256SUMS extended; server SBOM signed in release.yml server job which needed setup-go added). release.yml: new `release` job creates the GitHub release BEFORE agent/server jobs (they run in parallel; first v0.5.0 cut failed: server job "release not found" race — fix 2513256). syft version output: use awk '/^Version:/' (GoVersion/SchemaVersion also match). Local: docker.io installed + dockerd runs (no buildx plugin); gh token lacks read/write:packages so GHCR pull/push from local fails 403 (CI GITHUB_TOKEN fine). External skeptic pass v0.5.0: 29 assets, sha256sum -c 12/12, signer verify 14/14 incl all 6 SBOMs, SBOM sha matches binary. Commits: 4bc9b05 (claim) → fed58d3 (impl) → 2513256 (release-job race fix) → e68dc05 (board). GH runs: CI 32800383098 + Release 32800419608 green.

W4-2 COMPLETE + pushed (main). Agent verifies the release signature before auto-updating. Trust anchor = minisign public key pinned in-binary (agent/internal/update/minisign.pub, W3-4 key 019BF5A0CA5040DD; RMMWAY_UPDATE_PUBKEY overrides). Agent Updater (verify-only go-minisign 2023): manifest -> platform asset -> version gate (no downgrades) -> publisher-key gate (manifest.public_key must equal pinned) -> download bin+.minisig -> sha256 -> minisign -> atomic install (in-use .exe staged .pending) -> reexec. `rmmway-agent update [--check/--no-restart/--server]`; background auto-update in run (RMMWAY_AUTO_UPDATE, RMMWAY_UPDATE_INTERVAL, default 15m, on by default); ApplyPending at boot. Server: internal/releases serves GET /agent/releases/latest + /latest/<asset> (open, agent-facing) from RMMWAY_RELEASES_DIR, allowlisted from release.json (traversal-safe), manifest re-read per request (no restart on publish). cmd/publish-release assembles a release dir from agent/dist (requires each signed). Files: agent/internal/update/{pinned,verify,manifest,update,install,reexec_unix,reexec_windows,io}.go + _test + minisign.pub + testdata; server/internal/releases/{release,_test}.go; server/cmd/e2e/update/{main,serve}.go; server/cmd/publish-release/main.go. Commits: eaa6365 (impl), a9515a0 (board), e4a98a4 (ci yaml-quote fix). Rebased over W5-1 (self-healing heal pkg) which merged cleanly (conflicts only in httpapi.go/main.go/TASKS.md — both keep both Heal+Releases). All tests+e2e green; CI has `cd server && go run ./cmd/e2e/update`. Board now 21/28. NOTE: local heal e2e needs a CREATEDB role (default rmmway lacks it; use RMMWAY_PG_DSN=postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres).

W4-3 DONE (2026-08-25, /root/projects/rmmway). Per-client full export = no-lock-in promise. GET /api/devices/{id}/export (operator JWT) + /admin mirror, ?since=&until= RFC3339 + &rollups=0. Streams self-describing ZIP (server/internal/export): manifest.json (rmmway-client-bundle v1; per-file size+sha256+rows; self-size iterated to fixed point, manifest omits own sha256), device.json (inventory+config), metrics.parquet (raw samples streamed from hypertable: timestamp_ms,ts,name,source,value,labels-JSON; pure-Go github.com/parquet-go/parquet-go v0.32.0, no CGO), metrics_1m.parquet (rollups, full history), alerts.json (all statuses), README.md (duckdb/pandas/polars + sha256sum -c verify). export.Verify re-checks bundle vs OWN manifest incl. full decode of each parquet via standard reader. DeviceStore.Get added (store.ErrNotFound); memory helper renamed GetByID. httpapi deviceSub routes {id}/export; main.go builds export service when hasPG. e2e cmd/e2e/export (make export-e2e): scratch Timescale, real httpapi, 17280 samples (2d x 3 series), 401/404 gates, verify, tamper-reject, exact window (8640), standard re-read (ts==timestamp_ms all rows), re-import into fresh DB (identical count+range). CI: test job now has timescale/timescaledb:latest-pg16 service (POSTGRES_USER=rmmway, superuser via image default) + RMMWAY_TEST_PG_DSN job env -> previously-skipped live PG tests (W1-6/W2-3/W2-4/W5-1/W4-3) run in CI. Commits: 742a6d5 (claim) -> 635fa16 (impl, rebased over W5-2 e204f3c — conflicts: ci.yml clean, main.go/httpapi.go import+field adjacency (keep both), TASKS.md counts) -> dcc9518 (board). CI run 32881862005 green. Local e2e DSN: postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres (rmmway user lacks CREATEDB). Migrations now 6 (0006_flows.sql from W5-2); export e2e/test assert n>=5 not exact. go at /usr/local/go/bin.

W6-2 DONE (/root/projects/rmmway, main). Webhook + event-stream framework. server/internal/webhook (sign.go HMAC-SHA256 Stripe-style "t=<unix>,v1=<hex>", constant-time + VerifyWithin anti-replay; store.go PG; service.go framework) + migration 0007_webhooks.sql (webhooks endpoints w/ cursor/retry/dead-letter state + webhook_events journal, monotonic seq, category, data jsonb). flow.Event gained `Data map[string]any`; new flow.SubjectAlert/SubjectDevice. CategoryForSubject: alert->alert, device->inventory, flow.*/command.result->automation. Delivery: per-endpoint last_seq cursor; sweep (default 2s) delivers pending events (seq>last_seq AND category in endpoint.cats), 2xx->advance+reset attempts, else backoff 1s..5m, >=max_attempts(5)->status error (dead-letter, journal retained). New endpoints start at MAX(seq) (only new events). Replay=POST /webhooks/{id}/replay{from_seq,to_seq} resets cursor. SSE=GET /api/events/stream[/{cat}] (catch-up last 200 + live fan-out + Last-Event-ID). Emission hooks: alertStore.SetEventSink (fired/updated/resolved), ingest OnDeviceEvent (created/online), flow Notifier + heal Notifier + command results -> all publish to the W5-2 NATS bus. KEY BUG FIXED: flow engine + webhook framework must use SEPARATE durable NATS consumers on the same stream (same durable = "consumer already bound"); main.go now makes whBus (durable "webhook-engine") separate from flowBus ("flow-engine"). httpapi: Config.Webhooks; routes /api|admin/webhooks, /{id}, /{id}/replay, /{id}/events, /events/stream (open). cmd/e2e/webhook = DoD harness (real enroll->inventory, real flow trigger->notify->automation, real reconciler->alert over REAL NATS): 3 categories + HMAC verify (wrong secret rejected) + retry(500,500->200) + replay + SSE. CI: nats service (nats:2.10-alpine --jetstream --http_port 8222) + RMMWAY_NATS_URL + webhook e2e step. Makefile: webhook-e2e. Migrations now 7 (fixed count-asserts in 5 test files). Local test: RMMWAY_TEST_PG_DSN=postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/postgres (rmmway user lacks CREATEDB); NATS at nats://localhost:4222 (running, --jetstream). All green locally; 11 test pkgs + e2e PASS.
